facts.fact: Kenya's Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy is named with the ministries of Nigeria, Togo, Namibia and Benin as announcing ATLAS Umoja AI, a pan-African initiative on African-language AI, on 2026-07-24 alongside the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja; no agreement signing is stated.

systems.owner: GSMA with the governments of Benin, Kenya, Namibia, Nigeria and Togo

note: The Abuja Ministerial Declaration is adopted by ministers at the ATU conference but the document does not name Kenya as a party, so no fact is taken from it.
